rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a material structural template: both memoranda withhold approval because an otherwise useful bill would create or impose an objectionable administrative arrangement, expressly preserve a desirable grant of authority, and urge Congress to enact revised legislation retaining the useful authority without the institutional defect. C03 has a similar good-provision/bad-provision veto structure, while C07 shares the more specific objection to creating special-purpose commissions and assigning responsibilities outside established governmental channels. The strongest relationship is structural rather than based on distinctive verbatim language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: One provision of H.R. 6596 would authorize the Secretary of the Interior to contract for coal research. This feature of the bill is highly desirable and I urge the Congress to enact legislation granting such authority to the Secretary.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Although H.R. 6839 would grant desirable authority to the Postmaster General to enter into lease-purchase agreements ... it contains a provision ... that I feel I cannot give my approval.
shared_material.explanation: Both isolate a desirable executive authority within a bill whose administrative structure nevertheless compels disapproval.

shared_material.child_excerpt: H.R. 3375, or S. 1362, now pending in the Congress, would accomplish this purpose
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope that the Congress will, at its next session, give further consideration to legislation to accomplish the purposes of H.R. 6839, and that it will frame legislation free from the difficulties which impel me to withhold my approval
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by requesting revised or alternative legislation that preserves the bill's useful purpose while removing the objectionable machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: If an additional agency for this purpose were now to be created, the Department of the Interior's established interest in such matters would be diluted and the result could only be a blurring of the lines of governmental responsibility
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it contains a provision which would infringe upon the functions of the Executive branch
shared_material.explanation: The central objection in each is institutional: the proposed arrangement improperly interferes with or disperses established executive responsibility.
